_note: release/39 canonical Autonom mainnet feed map. adrena_feed_id range 30..141 reserved for Autonom (see adrena/programs/adrena/src/state/pool.rs OracleProvider::feed_id_range). Crypto block 30-35 mirrors ChaosLabs (0-5) order: SOL, jitoSOL, BTC, WBTC, BONK, USDC. WBTC reuses Autonom BTC canonical (3001) as proxy until a dedicated WBTC product exists — two adrena aliases (32, 33) intentionally point at the same canonical, the autonom backend signs each requested alias separately so on-chain receives feed_id=32 and feed_id=33 with the same price. Commodities block: 36=XAU (Gold), 37=XAG (Silver), 38=WTI (Crude). Equities block: 39=SPX500 (S&P 500 Index, canonical 7001), 40=NVDA (NVIDIA, canonical 1022) — first US equity perps. Slot 39 was previously reserved for XBR (Brent, canonical 2059) but never wired to the program on chain; reclaimed for SPX500. Future feeds (additional equities, indices, FX, etc.) append at 41+ in coordinated releases. The autonom backend at autonom/src/operator/web2/products/config/feed_id_aliases.json must mirror these adrena_feed_id -> autonom_feed_id pairs.

autonom_feed_map._comment: Uses Autonom BTC canonical (3001) as WBTC proxy. Two adrena aliases (32, 33) map to the same canonical; backend signs each requested alias separately so on-chain receives feed_id=32 and feed_id=33 with the same price.

S&P 500 Index. Autonom product ticker is 'SPX' (asset_class=INDEX, exchange=US_INDEX, exchange_policy=index); 'SPX500' is the canonical alias used here for human readability and matches autonom-side test pins. Sessioned by NYSE/Nasdaq RTH via market_hours_svc.
NVIDIA. Autonom product (asset_class=EQUITY, exchange=NASDAQ, exchange_policy=equity_ca, ISIN US67066G1040). Sessioned by NASDAQ RTH; corporate-action aware on the autonom side.
